Maria (Partnerships): :wave: Quick sync — we need a simple, shareable plan for SI partners to upload marketplace compliance artifacts (SOC, pen-test zips, questionnaires). Main asks: redaction expectations, presign TTL, who owns final QA for NDA-scoped files? Can we draft a short checklist to hand to SIs?
Kevin (Security): IMO: require redaction of PII before upload where possible. Mark anything NDA-scoped as `sensitive`. Presign TTL should be 24h by default for partners, shorter for public links. Final signoff on redaction stays with Security.
Ola (SI): We can ask partners to upload a single tarball (gz/zip). Any constraints on naming/schema? Also can we provide a presign endpoint rather than credentials?
Sam (Ops): Yes we have an evidence-ingest presign service. Current default TTL is 6h but we can bump to 24h per-policy. Endpoint: `https://evidence.redwood.ai/presign`. Example request:```bash
curl -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"key":"acme/partner-name/pen-2023.zip","contentType":"application/zip","ttl":86400}' \
  https://evidence.redwood.ai/presign
```
Lucas (Eng): FYI the ingestion pipeline will sanitize filenames, run a malware scan, and compute checksums. We can also run an automated redaction pass for common PII patterns but it needs sample data and Security approval before enabling.
Kevin (Security): Automation OK as first pass. Manual QA required on a sample set for each SI (especially 3rd-party pen reports). Retention: default 5 years for SOC/pen, access logged + role-based access (partners-only until review).
Maria (Partnerships): Can we capture owners in a few bullets so I can send to SIs? Proposal: SI uploads -> Partnerships coordinates -> Ops stores + presign -> Security does redaction QA -> Partnerships confirms acceptance to partner.
Sam (Ops): That works. Suggested lifecycle tags on upload: `presign:24h`, `retention:5y`, `access:partners-only`. We can change TTL config per-partner if needed.
Ola (SI): Can someone paste a short checklist I can hand to partners (redaction checklist + example presign command)? I want one doc to share.
Kevin (Security): Draft checklist (one-liner bullets) we usually send: - Remove full SSNs, replace with `XXX-XX-1234` - Mask account IDs - Remove screenshots with PII - Provide signed attestation if full raw logs required. Also add: "If you cannot redact due to contract, mark as NDA and provide contact for secure transfer." Link to internal checklist: https://redwood.internal/docs/sec/si-evidence-checklist (for security team).
Sam (Ops): Quick presign example (curl) is above — include `Content-MD5` header if available. Also recommend partners upload a small metadata JSON alongside the artifact: `artifact-metadata.json` with fields `vendor`, `artifact_type`, `scan_date`, `contact_email`.
Lucas (Eng): We'll need one sample artifact to validate the redaction automation and ingestion flow. Ola — can you arrange one partner test upload this week?
Ola (SI): Yep, I'll schedule a dry-run with ACME SI tomorrow morning. Will use the presign flow.
Kevin (Security): :thumbsup: Please tag me on the dry-run. We'll do a quick manual QA.
Maria (Partnerships): Great — I'll assemble the short checklist + presign instructions and post to partners channel. Final question: should NDA artifacts get a different presign TTL or access model?
Sam (Ops): Recommend treat NDA artifacts with same presign flow but limit TTL to 24h and set `access:narrow` + require explicit Security ACL. We can set `requires-review:true` tag.
Ola (SI): Noted. Can evidence-bot post when test upload occurs?
Ola (SI): @evidence-bot please notify.
evidence-bot: Uploaded artifact `acme-pen-2023.zip` by Ola (SI) via presign, size=42MB, md5=1a2b3c4d. Timestamp=1705554375
Maria (Partnerships): Thanks all — plan: I'll push checklist and the presign snippet, schedule dry-run, and capture owners. Leaving action items: Ola to run dry-run (due 1705630000), Kevin to QA sample, Sam to flip TTL config if needed. :white_check_mark:
